decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher builds on the firm's core postpress application and service know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and keep refining it.

UV spot varnishing lies outside the firm's established knowledge base, which limits its absorptive capacity, but the Duplo partnership and its flagship role in the enhancement direction justify retaining it for another year.
The sheet preparation module extends the firm's modular systems and complements the portfolio, so it is easy to assimilate and support.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship at the heart of the firm's multifinishing competence and fits its automation direction.
The hybrid saddle stitcher draws on long-standing booklet-making expertise, which lets the firm learn from customer feedback and improve the product.
The folding add-on is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation running in one pass, which gives interpretable results to build on.
